title: Fitts tells Tucker Carlson the money goes to space

tellings.quote: And I I believe in her Tucker Carlson interview she mentions your work and he's like, "Where is all this money going?" And she goes, "Well, talk to Richard Dolan." And she goes, "Space."

plain: Katherine Austin Fitz, a woman who speaks about money missing from the US government's books, is said to have told Tucker Carlson that the money goes to space. Michels recounts it to his guest, the UFO historian Richard Dolan: Carlson asked "Where is all this money going?", she said "Well, talk to Richard Dolan," and then "Space." If true, it would mean huge sums of hidden public money are funding a secret space effort.
